description: This file contains a set of unit tests for Orleans streaming reliability, including tests for silo restarts, silo joins, stream message delivery, and pub/sub behavior, implemented using xUnit framework.

classes.name: StreamReliabilityTests
classes.description: A test class implementing various reliability tests for Orleans streaming, including silo restart, join, and failure scenarios.

methods.name: GetGrain
methods.description: Retrieves a grain of type IStreamReliabilityTestGrain with the specified grainId.

methods.name: CreateGrainOnSilo
methods.description: Creates or locates a grain that runs on the specified silo.

methods.name: CheckConsumerProducerStatus
methods.description: Checks the status of producer and consumer grains regarding their roles in a stream.

methods.name: CheckReceivedCounts
methods.description: Verifies the number of messages received and errors by a consumer grain.

methods.name: CheckConsumerCounts
methods.description: Verifies the number of consumers connected to a stream.

methods.name: RestartAllSilos
methods.description: Restarts all silos in the test cluster.

methods.name: StopSilo
methods.description: Stops or kills a specified silo, with options to restart.
